title: Yearly forest loss and oil-palm area by first-level region (Southeast Asia, 11 countries)

units.loss_ha: hectares of tree-cover loss in the year (Hansen GFC v1.13, treecover2000>=30%)
units.palm_ha_cum: cumulative hectares of oil palm planted in or before the year (Descals 2024 YoP; 1989 = 1989 or earlier); null after 2021 (no planting-year data); null for every year in countries with no dated oil-palm map (Laos, Vietnam, Timor-Leste)

notes: Pixels outside the geoBoundaries ADM1 polygons are not counted in any region. Each country is counted on its own, so a border sliver inside two countries' polygons counts for both.
Hansen loss total over all pixels in the tiles used (incl. sea and neighbouring countries) in 'unassigned_loss_ha_all_pixels'.

Descals 2024 only has tiles where it mapped oil palm: see palm_no_tile_share (share of the region area with no tile). Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Philippines are oil-palm-only maps (other plantation crops are not mapped).
palm_ha_cum is null for all years in Laos, Vietnam, Timor-Leste (no dated oil-palm data): 'not assessed', not 'zero'.
Indonesian, Malaysian, Brunei and Singapore series are the live / tier-B values unchanged (a rebuild of them in the same run matched; see build report).
Series 'all' = sum of the 11 national series (null where any country has no data for the field).
